versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the pdf-label-made-in-china skill.
- Enables batch addition of "Made In China" text to Amazon FBA product label PDFs, positioned below specified text (e.g., product name) and center-aligned with the barcode.
- Supports both single-label PDFs and mixed-label PDFs (multiple barcode types per PDF).
- Provides adjustable y_position parameter for precise text placement; includes test page generation option for preview.
- Handles standard Amazon labels and FBA warehouse/mixed SKU labels with different positioning needs.
- Offers usage instructions, troubleshooting, and best practices for output verification.
